description.text: The study schedule for undergraduates is four years. The students should take credit within four years and finish the graduate thesis. Those who pass the examinations can get the graduation certificate and bachelor degree certificate.

duration.text: The Light Chemical Engineering at Hebei University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Letter of guardian’s guarantee For applicant under 18 years of age Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 50 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3.HSK level C (or above)
